correctness.rationale: Complete exact enumeration of 32767 nonzero degree-four coefficient masks via 279 verified disjoint GL3(F2) orbits (sum weights 32767). Ten weighted bins sum 10920; blocking s=0 sums 3888, 25 orbits. Complete reproducible standard-library checker passed; separate symbolic Gröbner check agreed. Risk: code has not undergone external independent audit.

value.rationale: The natural blocking property of smooth projective plane curves is an explicit research question; q=2 degree=4 is the first binary genus-three plane family. Exact conditional density 162/455 offers a finite benchmark for asymptotic smooth-blocking theory. Ten joint point/skew-line bins and 25 blocking projective classes distinguish incidence that rational point count alone cannot decide. This is a complete finite invariant with direct geometric motivation, not an arbitrary cutoff or a textbook inference.
